slide1.title: Feel the city, now
slide1.body: Challenges are little real-world dares between people in a city — and across cities.

slide2.title: Frame a challenge
slide2.body: Set a meet (a date + a place) or a photo challenge with a deadline. You're the host.

slide3.title: Anyone just joins
slide3.body: No asking, no waiting — whoever's in joins. You get +2 right away.

slide4.title: Make it happen
slide4.body: Everyone shows up together at your meet — or submits their best photo before the deadline.

slide5.title: You validate
slide5.body: Afterwards you confirm who was present, or pick the winning photo. That's where the big points land.

slide6.title: Across cities
slide6.body: Photo challenges work at a distance — challenge a whole other city to send their best shot.

slide7.title: Climb Most Local
slide7.body: Show up and win to rise on the board. Join-sparks stay small, so it's always about really doing it.
